description: Save the channel rates for your workspace. A price request that names a saved channel (the channel argument of compute_price) is raised so you keep the same amount after the channel's cut. Your price guardrails still hold the raised price. This replaces the whole list: a channel left out is removed, so read get_channel_rates first and send every channel you want to keep. An empty list removes them all. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

rates.description: Every channel to keep, at most 25. Each channel name appears once.

channel.description: The channel name, as sent in compute_price: letters, digits, _ and -, starting with a letter or digit. Matched case-insensitively.

cut_pct.description: What the channel keeps of the sale, in percent, from 0 to 60.

passed_on_pct.description: How much of that cut is added to the price, in percent. 100 (the default) keeps your amount whole; 0 leaves the price as it is.

name: set_channel_rates
